notablePrerequisites:
Vorapede does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a basic land.
description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Vorapede, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Vorapede.
Vorapede's undying ability triggers, returning Vorapede from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Vorapede, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Vorapede, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling token, untapping the basic land.
Repeat from step 2.
